title: Dedicated throughput acceptance protocol and benchmark methodology for customer sign-off
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable, auditable benchmark methodology and customer acceptance test (CAT) for Dedicated capacity throughput guarantees. This ticket produces: a test protocol document for SRE/QA, an updated load harness configuration set, Grafana dashboards and alerts for CAT runs, an acceptance checklist for sales/solutions engineers, and a runbook for executing customer sign-off tests. Scope: synthetic steady-state throughput runs, burst and degrade scenarios, autoscaler responsiveness validation, and end-to-end customer-facing latency/availability checks. Excludes model training workloads and extended multi-day cost analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Published benchmark protocol doc in Confluence with step-by-step run instructions and required infra pre-checks.
Load harness configs for the three official traffic profiles (steady, burst, mixed) committed to the loadgen repo.
Grafana dashboards and a recorded demo run showing metrics capture for a full CAT execution.
All PASS/FAIL criteria are actionable and documented; engineering owner and SRE have validated the checklist.
Customer acceptance checklist created and reviewed by solutions engineering and a pilot customer (internal test account).
test_plan_steps: 1) Provision a dedicated pool matching the customer SKU and model variant; verify node image and runtime-1.21.
2) Run infra pre-checks: GPU health, network egress checks, KV cache warmup snapshot available.
3) Execute warmup phase: 10 minutes of low-rate traffic to populate KV caches and establish baseline batching.
4) Run steady-state throughput profile for 30 minutes at target QPS to validate sustained throughput and p95 latency.
5) Run burst profile: short 3-minute high-QPS bursts to exercise autoscaler; record scaling events and scale-up latency.
6) Run degrade scenario: intentionally reduce capacity (drain N nodes) and observe graceful degradation and fallback policies.
7) Capture telemetry: token-level cost, batching histograms, queue sizes, GPU utilization, error rates, and autoscaler logs.
8) Execute cleanup and produce a run artifact bundle (metrics exports, logs, harness config) for postmortem.
9) Prepare customer-facing report and review with solutions engineering within 48 hours of test completion.
traffic_profiles: steady-1: sustained 80% of committed throughput for 30 minutes with 99% requests using payload size P1 (512 tokens), inter-arrival ~Poisson.
burst-1: three 3-minute bursts at 3x sustained QPS separated by 10-minute cool-downs; payload mix P1/P2 (50/50).
mixed-latency: intermittent short requests (50% small 64-token) and long completions (50% 1024-token) to validate KV cache and batching behavior.
metrics_to_collect: GPU utilization and memory utilization per node,
batch size distribution and average tokens per batch,
queue length and request wait time,
cost estimates per 1M tokens for run (based on runtime telemetry).
pass_fail_thresholds: Throughput: achieved sustained tokens/sec within +/-5% of promised SLA for a continuous 30-minute window -> PASS, else FAIL.
Latency: p95 response-time-to-first-token must be <= SLA target (customer-specific); default target = 250ms -> PASS if met.
Error rate: overall 5xx + timeout rate must be < 0.5% for the test interval -> PASS.

Autoscaler: on burst profile, scale-up must start within 45s of sustained increased queue depth and reach target capacity within 3x scale-up latency limit -> PASS when observed events align with policy.
Graceful degradation: when capacity is reduced, fallback model variant or queued requests must maintain availability >= 99% -> PASS.

notes: Run isolation: use dedicated VPC with no cross-tenant traffic to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
Warmup recommendations: run warmup until average batch size stabilizes for 5 consecutive minutes.
Known caveat: quantized model variants may have different token throughput profiles; tests must explicitly declare model variant used.
Next actions: automate artifact collection (metrics+logs) into a single tarball and add CAT run summary to onboarding template for sales.
